note: OpenRouter's closed-weight share of tokens. 'weeks' come from OpenRouter's weekly Top Models chart (all tokens, prompt + completion): closed / open = that week's named top models by published weights, others = the chart's 'Others' bucket, which OpenRouter does not split, so the week's closed share lies between closed/total and (closed + others)/total. 'reads' are this project's reads of OpenRouter's full weekly ranking (every model, trailing seven days), classified model by model: the complete split on the days it was read. Open = weights published (registry flag where the model is mapped, else a non-empty hf_slug in OpenRouter's catalog). OpenRouter rankings are CC BY 4.0.
